text: In the empirical ESP lab, a reservoir with rho = 0.1 forgets its initial condition (its trajectories converge) more SLOWLY than a reservoir with rho = 0.99.
explanation: False, the direction is reversed. The lab reports that rho = 0.1 converges within about 10 steps (rapid forgetting) while rho = 0.99 converges very slowly as it approaches the ESP boundary. The log-distance decays at rate ~ log(rho) per step, so a smaller rho gives faster convergence and a shorter effective washout.
